description:
Brand Introduction:

Welcome to BAD-UY FITS, a brand rooted in Filipino culture, humor, and creativity. We specialize in unique, fun, and playful apparel that embraces Filipino pride with a twist of puns and nostalgia. Our clothing line includes t-shirts, hoodies, and seasonal collections, all designed to bring smiles and good vibes to people everywhere.

Product Description:

BAD-UY FITS offers high-quality, print-on-demand (POD) apparel featuring bold designs with a retro 80s vibe. Our collections include Filipino-themed puns, humor-filled graphics, and seasonal specials like our Spooky Season range. Our t-shirts and hoodies are made with comfortable, durable materials, perfect for everyday wear or as statement pieces for any occasion.

Unique Selling Point (USP):

Our USP lies in our one-of-a-kind, Filipino-inspired designs. Each piece tells a story and brings out the fun in everyday life with witty puns and playful artwork. We also offer seasonal exclusives and limited-edition drops, ensuring that there's always something fresh and exciting for our customers to discover.

Payment Terms:

Affiliates will earn a flat $3 commission on every sale generated through their referral link. Commissions are tracked and paid out monthly via PayPal (or other preferred payment method) once the minimum payout threshold of $50 is met. Affiliates must provide accurate payment details during the registration process to ensure timely payouts.

Other Information:

  • Promotional Tools: Affiliates will have access to a variety of promotional materials, including banners, high-quality product images, and pre-written copy to help drive sales.
  • Tracking & Transparency: Our UpPromote platform provides real-time tracking, so you can monitor your sales, clicks, and commissions with ease.
  • Support: Our team is here to support you every step of the way, offering guidance, tips, and updates on new product releases and promotions.
